description: A list of authorized software for organizational systems is not maintained or enforced. This signal indicates that unapproved or potentially malicious software may be installed without detection.
applicability: Applicable to all systems where software installation is possible. Includes application whitelisting, authorized software inventories, and software installation controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through software inventory review, application whitelist configuration assessment, and software installation policy verification.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
